requirements_to_testpoints.stimulus: Apply current ADC values 716 and 717 and temperature ADC values 122 and 123. Exercise each combination with vibration inactive, then active, then released. Observe the status display page.
requirements_to_testpoints.oracle: Calibrations are ADC*10/1023 amperes and ADC*500/1023 Celsius. Status is 3 during vibration, otherwise 2 above 60 Celsius, otherwise 1 above 7 amperes, otherwise 0. Release immediately recomputes status without latching.
requirements_to_testpoints.requirement_text:
设计一个工业电机运行监测系统，使用电流传感器 A0、温度传感器 LM35（A1）、振动开关 D2、风扇 PWM D5、蜂鸣器 D6、LED D13 和串口。系统实时监测电机负载、温升和振动，给出正常、过载、过热、机械异常四种状态；过热时开启风扇冷却，机械异常时优先报警并输出 fault code。TM1637（CLK=D4，DIO=D5）用于轮流显示电流、温度和状态编号。
Disclosed configurable bench calibration/thresholds: A0 current=ADC*10/1023 amperes; LM35 A1 Celsius=ADC*500/1023 with5V ADC reference. Overload current>7A, overheat>60C; vibration switch active uses the declared electrical input semantics. Status0 normal,1 overload, 2 overheat,3 mechanical fault; mechanical fault has highest priority, then overheat. Fan PWM255 above60C and0 otherwise. Mechanical fault drives audible/LED alarm and Serial fault code3. TM1637 rotates integer current in amperes, integer temperature Celsius, and status code every2s.

requirements_to_testpoints.stimulus: Change temperature ADC between 122 and 123 with both vibration states and both low and high current.
requirements_to_testpoints.oracle: Fan command is respectively 0 and 255, independent of current and mechanical-fault priority, and changes within 250 ms.

requirements_to_testpoints.stimulus: Start with vibration active; hold, release, reactivate, hold, and release again. Also repeat starting inactive. Drive physical D2 LOW for active and HIGH for inactive.
requirements_to_testpoints.oracle: Each fault entry, including an initially active first sample, emits exactly one unprefixed integer line 3 at 9600 baud. Held faults do not repeat reports. Active faults command a continuous 1000 Hz tone and illuminated LED; release silences the tone and extinguishes the LED within 250 ms.

requirements_to_testpoints.stimulus: Apply distinct current, temperature, and status values. Advance io_7 across 2000, 4000, and 6000 ms boundaries and through multiple complete cycles, including a delta spanning several pages. Change sensor inputs and release vibration within a selected page.
requirements_to_testpoints.oracle: Display begins with floored current amperes, switches to floored Celsius at 2000 ms, and to current status at 4000 ms; the cycle repeats every 6000 ms with residual elapsed time preserved. Selected values refresh each step without resetting rotation. TM1637 uses the resolved D4 clock and D3 data wiring.
